task: Make the Temperature field in CodeMie UI model-aware so Claude Sonnet models (Bedrock and Vertex) allow only 0–1 while other models keep their current 0–2 range, covering both AssistantForm and VirtualAssistantForm.

key_reasoning.reason: Six frontend components must change in lock-step: ModelOption type (configuration.ts), getLLMModels store (appInfo.ts), named constants (validation.ts), AssistantForm Yup schema, AssistantSetupSection Input render, and VirtualAssistantForm (independent duplicate of both schema and render). Bumped from M to L by the 'touches core shared utilities' red flag (configuration.ts and validation.ts are repo-wide shared utilities).

This is the first per-model conditional UI behavior in the codebase — no existing end-to-end pattern to follow. The implementer must choose between Yup.when() (requires accessing appInfoStore as a side-effect inside the schema callback) or Yup context option (cleaner but more wiring), without clear guidance from form-patterns.md. The existing integration test asserts the old message and old placeholder and will fail immediately, requiring a selector strategy change.

Seven modified files (configuration.ts, appInfo.ts, validation.ts, AssistantForm.tsx, AssistantSetupSection.tsx, VirtualAssistantForm.tsx, NewAssistantPage.integration.test.tsx) plus 1–2 new files (formSchema.ts if guide mandate is followed; new VirtualAssistantForm integration test). Spans 4–5 directories: src/types/entity/, src/store/, src/constants/, src/pages/assistants/, src/pages/workflows/editor/.
